data.name: Rima
data.gender_notes: Rima is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is the embodiment of joy, melody, and rhythm. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ritambhara' meaning 'full of rhythm'. The name Rima carries the meaning “Juice, Melody” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rima usually hope their child will grow to embody juice, melody and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a girl who embodies the essence of joy, rhythm, and melody. It is believed to bring harmony, balance, and creativity in life.
data.etymology: Rima belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Juice, Melody.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rima total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

The name resonates with the sweet sounds of Indian classical music and poetry, reminding us of the profound beauty and joy that can be found in life.
